pages.text: A Murdergleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a yellow-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in an asscher cut.$(br2)When toggled on, a Murdergleam guarantees that all of your attacks will be critical hits. Each attack drains a point of charge (even attacks that deal no damage due to attacking too quickly). The gem can be toggled on or off by left clicking.
When a Murdergleam runs out of charge, it automatically toggles itself off. Likewise, when it reaches full charge, it automatically toggles itself on.
Murdergleams can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
